title_zh: 京张续城：参与者就绪闭环（参考性专业交接包）
title_en: Jing-Zhang In Place: Participant Readiness Closure (reference professional handoff packet)
purpose: This participant-authored dossier turns the S01/S04/S07 concept boundary into a future professional handoff method. It is not a carrier selection, field survey, appointment, safety case approval, procurement package, commissioning record, budget, or operating authorization.

truth_boundary.rule: Every external prerequisite remains HOLD_EXTERNAL until a future rights-holder, qualified professional, and field process provide applicable evidence.

canonical_surfaces: proposal.md#参与者就绪闭环：让交接先于行动
reviewer_visible_contract.fixed_figure: assets/figures/metrics-evidence.png and its English counterpart summarize the STOP/RESET and external-HOLD boundary; this dossier supplies the complete reference method.

carrier_screen_reject_register.method: Screen a future candidate carrier before any specialist spatial delta. Any failed, absent, expired, or contradictory item returns the task to ordinary space, lower-tech reversible arrangement, or NO-BUILD.

screen_items.requirement: rights, tenure, access scope, time window, and authorized signatory
screen_items.required_artifact: dated rights/access evidence with scope, expiry, revocation and signatory authority
screen_items.stop_if: authority is absent, expired, narrower than the proposed use, or cannot be independently checked

screen_items.requirement: ordinary-route, accessibility, public-service, and maintenance continuity
screen_items.required_artifact: current route/accessibility/maintenance observation and professional review record
screen_items.stop_if: the ordinary baseline would be narrowed, obscured, queued across, or made dependent on an AI state

screen_items.requirement: task, data, equipment, utilities, structural, fire/life-safety and isolation preconditions
screen_items.required_artifact: bounded task packet plus applicable professional and carrier interface evidence
screen_items.future_verifier_role_type: qualified professional and carrier interface reviewer
screen_items.stop_if: any required task, data, utility, structural, life-safety, or isolation condition is unverified
screen_items.fallback: simulation, review, ordinary room, or NO-BUILD

screen_items.requirement: separate role competence, human stop authority, maintenance/reset custody, and independent witnessing
screen_items.required_artifact: role-type appointment, competence evidence, handoff record, and stop/reset escalation route
screen_items.future_verifier_role_type: future authorized carrier and independent acceptance witness
screen_items.stop_if: one person or unqualified role combines incompatible operation, safety, and acceptance decisions

participant_reference_task_packet.purpose: A bounded reference mission asks whether a supervised physical validation need can justify a minimum reversible edge after ordinary simulation, code review, and ordinary rooms are shown insufficient.

inputs.data_boundary: No personal or public ambient data is assumed; any data use requires a future lawful, cleared and role-approved boundary.

success_categories: all applicable future gates are evidenced
reset and ordinary-baseline restoration are independently recorded
participant_reference_task_packet.stop_condition: Any failure category preserves P0_GO=false and returns the concept to ordinary space, lower-tech reversible arrangement, or NO-BUILD.
participant_reference_task_packet.reset_evidence: future dated inventory, isolation/lockout state, incident/deviation record, and independent ordinary-baseline verification; no duration is asserted.

role_type_raci_handoff.action: bound the task, equipment and data interface
role_type_raci_handoff.responsible_role_type: task initiator with qualified professional review

role_type_raci_handoff.action: verify safety, accessibility, utilities and lockout prerequisites
run, stop, isolate and reset a future bounded session
role_type_raci_handoff.responsible_role_type: qualified operator and separate human safety authority
role_type_raci_handoff.handoff_artifact: session, incident, lockout and reset record

role_type_raci_handoff.action: accept or reject return to ordinary baseline

generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.future_control: ordinary baseline observation, protected clear route, human stop and immediate removal
generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.lockout_or_no_go: No session if route/accessibility evidence is absent or a conflict is observed.

generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.future_control: applicable professional review, carrier interface confirmation, physical isolation and controlled inventory
generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.lockout_or_no_go: No activation without verified applicable isolation conditions.

generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.future_control: applicable qualified professional assessment and carrier-specific emergency/egress review
generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.lockout_or_no_go: No setup, occupancy, or task if required assessment is absent or contradictory.

generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.future_control: minimum-data boundary, human appeal route, paper/non-digital fallback and stop authority
generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.lockout_or_no_go: No task if lawful basis, consent boundary, appeal route, or human fallback is absent.

generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.future_control: stop, isolate, quarantine, incident/deviation record, inventory and independent baseline restoration
generic_hazard_lockout_no_go.lockout_or_no_go: No further session until an independent witness records complete ordinary-baseline restoration.

procurement_cost_boundary.capex_formula: sum(defensible quantity x dated applicable public unit-rate range) + documented installation/inspection allowance + explicit uncertainty reserve
procurement_cost_boundary.opex_formula: role-hours + setup/reset labor + inspection/certification + storage/transport + utilities/consumables + replacement reserve
procurement_cost_boundary.cross_reference: The 15 existing renewal project families retain their counts and evidence boundary; this dossier adds no cost tier or delivery commitment.
